text: Elgnad, also spelled Dealgnaid, is an Irish heroine. She is the wife of the invader Partholón, who carried her with him to Ireland. While he was away winning new ground and had left her with the servant Togda, the two became companions in a closed house. When Partholón came home and found this, he did not lay the fault on her, saying it was his own leaving that had caused it. The pair were reconciled, and from her the old stock of the isle descends.
